```text
Print client version

Usage:
  kbld version [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for version

Global Flags:
      --color            Set color output (default true)
      --column strings   Filter to show only given columns
      --json             Output as JSON
      --tty              Force TTY-like output
  -y, --yes              Assume yes for any prompt
```
